title: Greg Hunt
text:
About


I am an academic statistician with over a decade of experience. I have an M.A. and Ph.D. in Statistics from the University of Michigan and undergraduate degrees in mathematics and computer science. My work combines statistical methodology, applied data analysis, machine learning, reproducible computing, and interdisciplinary research. I have a record of collaboration across biomedical research, engineering, scientific computing, and applied data analysis, with an emphasis on careful modeling, transparent computation, and clear communication of statistical results.






NoteIndependent consulting



Consulting work described on this site is independent and is not offered on behalf of, reviewed by, or endorsed by William & Mary.

title: Greg Hunt
text:
Services
I provide independent statistical consulting for individuals and organizations that need careful quantitative reasoning, reproducible analysis, and clear communication of results.
Example services include:



Design


Study design
Support for research questions, experimental structure, measurement plans, replication strategies, and analysis plans.




Planning


Power and simulation
Power analysis, sample size planning, simulation studies, and sensitivity checks for designs.




Modeling


Statistical modeling
Regression, ANOVA, generalized linear models, mixed models, clustering, dimensionality reduction, exploratory analysis, and visualization.




Prediction


Machine learning
Applied machine learning for prediction, approximation, feature engineering, model evaluation, and scientific data analysis.




Workflow


Reproducible analysis
Transparent analysis workflows using modern tool stacks such as R, Python, Quarto, Jupyter, Docker, and Git.




Communication


Manuscripts and grants
Statistical review, methods sections, reviewer responses, analysis documentation, and grant proposal support.

title: Greg Hunt
text:
Areas of expertise
My expertise spans statistical and data science methodology broadly, including applied data analysis, machine learning, and scientific computing. I have experience with applications in biomedical research, high-throughput imaging, omics, spectroscopy, engineering, social sciences, and other applied domains.

title: Greg Hunt
text:
Who I work with
I work with individuals, researchers, organizations, and teams who need help making sense of data, planning analyses, or answering quantitative questions carefully.
Projects can range from a brief consultation or review of an existing approach to a focused analysis or longer-term statistical support.
